baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction jazaan bima kanu yamalun links recompense to what they were intentionally doing.
baseline_models.mechanism: JZY supplies action answered by a corresponding return, AML supplies purposive action, and KWN situates that activity as an enacted past reality; the result is fitted recompense rather than an unrelated gift.

activation_trace.role: Action met by its recompense supplies the focus verse's corresponding return.
Occurrence and presence in time make the answered activity an enacted past reality.
Intentional action identifies the conduct to which the return corresponds.

changed_reading.before: A reward follows something they did.
changed_reading.after: The scene is a corresponding return keyed to intentional activity they had actually sustained.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Jazaan and yamalun can be read through the focus inventories' debt-satisfaction and worker-wage branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Debt satisfaction and a worker's wage form an accounting mechanism: work accrues a claim and jazaa discharges it.

activation_trace.role: Collection and satisfaction of debt frame jazaa as closure of an accrued claim.
A worker's wage makes the discharged claim labor-generated.

changed_reading.before: The verse names a generic prize after deeds.
changed_reading.after: The recompense is a settlement that fully answers labor's outstanding claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing kanu yamalun joins temporal being to AML's image of one formed or fitted for work.
baseline_models.mechanism: KWN extends activity through time while AML's work-fitted branch shifts attention from atomized deeds to a practiced disposition; recompense can answer a settled way of operating.

activation_trace.role: Corresponding recompense remains the governing relation.
Temporal occurrence lets repeated practice appear as an enduring past mode.
Being formed for work turns repeated action into a work-shaped disposition.

changed_reading.before: Separate completed deeds receive separate returns.
changed_reading.after: The return answers a habituated practice, the kind of activity they had become fitted to sustain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event fixes into reality, reverses vertical rank, and gathers people into work-shaped kinds; recompense therefore manifests as an assigned mode of being and public station, not merely as a later token.

activation_trace.role: Corresponding return anchors the rank change as recompense rather than arbitrary sorting.
Place and status derived from being let the return take the form of an attained station.
Intentional work remains the focus-grounded basis of the manifested station.
Falling and becoming fixed turn the announced event into actualization.
Lowering after height supplies the downward half of the public rank reversal.
Elevation of standing supplies the upward half of the public rank reversal.
Peers gathered by shared form or work make the three outcomes coherent cohorts.

structural_cues: 56:1-7 sequences an undeniable occurrence, vertical reversal, pulverization, and 'you became three classes' before the classes are named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an event that fixes, lowers, raises, and groups; I infer that this sequence externalizes the correspondence named in 56:24 as rank and station. A live alternative is that it only stages the recipients before recompense is named.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is a corresponding benefit delivered after work.
changed_reading.after: Their work is returned as a publicly manifested rank and mode of being within the new order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The return takes social and spatial form: companioned cohorts, precedence, favored nearness, collective abundance, interwoven supports, and mutual facing configure belonging rather than isolated possession.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in place of another lets recompense take the form of a replacement social situation.
Place and standing make the replacement situation a stable social station.
Dealings between people anchor the social character of what is answered.
Companionship and sustained association define recipients as relational groups.
Precedence and racing introduce ordered position within the groups.
Favored nearness to the sovereign supplies privileged relational proximity.
A gathered company makes abundance collective rather than merely numerical.
Tightly interwoven construction gives the social arrangement a materially integrated support.
Face-to-face orientation turns nearness into reciprocal presence.

structural_cues: 56:8-16 moves from repeated group labels through precedence and nearness to collective counts, shared furnishings, and mutual orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cohorts, rank, proximity, woven supports, and facing; I infer that these are the form taken by recompense, not only its backdrop. The live alternative is a conventional scene arrangement with no return-to-dealings mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Recompense relocates recipients into a communal topology of belonging, nearness, and unobstructed mutual presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those previously characterized by work now occupy the center while enduring service and provision circulate around them; the source keeps flowing, and reception transfers neither headache nor depletion.

activation_trace.role: Corresponding return anchors the reversal of labor and provision as recompense.
Manual workers make prior embodied labor the human pole of the reversal.
Circling around a center makes service mobile while recipients remain at rest.
Young attendants supply the agents who bear the circulating service.
Enduring stability removes decay from the service arrangement.
A flowing spring supplies provision from a continuing source.
Headache names the bodily fracture explicitly excluded from reception.

structural_cues: The sequence 56:17-19 places circulating service around reclining recipients and then negates both headache and the branchless n-z-f depletion/intoxication cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulation, enduring attendants, a spring, and negated harm or depletion; I infer a reversal from workers to served recipients and from extractive consumption to nondepleting provision. A live alternative is simply a luxury banquet without labor-economic force.

changed_reading.after: Labor is answered by a durable ecology in which service and provision circulate without transferring strain or exhausting their source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intentionality is preserved across the transition: purposive work is answered not by a fixed ration but by fruit selected and food desired, so recipients participate in the form their recompense takes.

activation_trace.role: Corresponding recompense supplies the answer side of the agency-preserving relation.
Purposive action supplies agency on the work side of the relation.
Desirable fruit supplies a concrete field in which selection operates.
Seeking the beneficial through choice makes reception elective rather than imposed.
The soul's movement toward what it wants makes provision responsive to desire.

structural_cues: The parallel mimma clauses in 56:20-21 subordinate offered fruit and meat to what recipients choose and desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection and desire in parallel provisions; I infer continuity between the agency of AML and agency within its return. A live alternative is that the clauses only emphasize abundance, not participation in recompense.

changed_reading.before: A corresponding return is externally fixed and handed over.
changed_reading.after: The return preserves agency as a responsive field in which transformed choice and desire help specify what is received.

context_deltas.mechanism: The labor claim is socially closed by removing speech that is worthless, injurious, or loads guilt onto another and replacing the whole audible exchange with repeated safety and peace.

activation_trace.role: Debt satisfaction makes the discourse transformation the closure of an account.
Interpersonal dealings identify the social field whose liabilities are settled.
Auditory reception defines the channel from which harmful exchange is removed.
What is discarded and given no account names speech with no constructive residue.
Loading guilt onto another names the accusatory liability explicitly excluded.
Uttered speech supplies the positive replacement rather than mere silence.
Repeated safety and freedom from harm make peaceful address the continuing social form of settlement.

structural_cues: 56:25-26 uses a negated hearing construction followed by an exception and doubles salam, replacing excluded speech with reiterated peace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no hearing of laghw or guilt-loading and then excepts repeated peace; I infer that this acoustic repair completes the settlement of prior dealings. A live alternative is that it describes paradisal decorum without an accounting relation.

changed_reading.before: The labor claim is settled by valuable goods.
changed_reading.after: The account is socially closed: no worthless or accusatory residue remains, and reciprocal peace becomes the ongoing form of recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it follows the packet's secondary JZY-to-JZZ mapping from recompense into ripeness for cutting. It remains anchored in the focus form, intentional AML, and the nearby fruit-and-choice sequence; downstream prose should label it an exploratory harvest resonance, not an etymological equation of JZY and JZZ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Jazaan at word 1 activates the packet-supplied JZZ branch for the time when produce is ripe to cut, while yamalun supplies prior cultivation-like effort.

activation_trace.role: Ripeness and the time for cutting recast the moment of recompense as harvest time.
Intentional work supplies what metaphorically matures toward that harvest.
Nearby desirable fruit makes the harvest mechanism locally visible.
Selection at reception makes the ripe yield available as a chosen harvest.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is paid after work is finished.
changed_reading.after: Recompense is the ripening point at which what intentional practice has grown becomes a harvest ready to be gathered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a secondary KNN-to-KWN mapping lets the concealed-pearl image reactivate KWN as custodial standing. It remains anchored by focus kanu, the packet's explicit split mapping, and KNN's protective cover; downstream prose should present it only as a nearby formal resonance and not as a lexical identification or a claim that persons are commodities.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kanu at word 3 is reactivated by nearby maknun and its packet-supplied KNN-to-KWN target, shifting being toward protected custody.

activation_trace.role: A recompense that stands in place of another thing allows the return to be a protected condition rather than a detachable object.
Custodial standing over someone supplies a protected mode of being at the focus anchor.
Protective concealment supplies the preserving enclosure.
The packet's secondary mapping bridges nearby concealment to KWN's custodial branch.
The pearl supplies value whose integrity depends on being kept and protected.

changed_reading.before: They simply existed as doers and later received valuable objects.
changed_reading.after: Their recompense can be heard as entry into a protected mode of being in which value is held intact rather than exposed or spent.

strongest_changes: Corresponding return became a manifested rank and mode of being within the event's new order.
Private compensation became a communal topology of precedence, nearness, interweaving, and mutual presence.
A worker's wage became nondepleting service and provision, then a participatory field of choice rather than a fixed ration.
Debt settlement became social and acoustic repair: accusatory residue disappears and repeated peace continues the return.
summary.what_was_special: The short focus verse acts as a hinge: its branches for correspondence, debt, being, wage, and dealings let the surrounding sequence turn recompense from an item into a realized social, material, and communicative environment.
remaining_uncertainties: The surrounding scenes may be appositional contents of jazaa, consequences of it, or simply its setting; the packet does not force one relation.
The habitual-disposition reading of kanu yamalun is plausible but less certain than ordinary sustained past activity.
The JZY-to-JZZ harvest and KNN-to-KWN custody activations depend on explicit secondary packet mappings and must remain exploratory.
